content: Facet neurotomy (rhizotomy) may be indicated when ALL of the following are present:

children.content: Chronic cervical or lumbar spinal pain (at least 3 months' duration) originating from 1 or more of the following:

children.question: Does the patient have chronic cervical or lumbar spinal pain lasting at least 3 months originating from the cervical spine following a whiplash injury?
Does the patient have chronic lumbar spinal pain lasting at least 3 months?

children.content: Failure of nonoperative management, as indicated by 1 or more of the following:

children.question: Has the patient participated in an exercise program as part of nonoperative management?

children.content: Physical therapy or spinal manipulation therapy
children.question: Has the patient undergone physical therapy or spinal manipulation therapy?

children.content: Imaging studies and physical examination have ruled out other causes of spinal pain (eg, herniated disk, spinal stenosis, fracture, tumor).
children.question: Have imaging studies and physical examination ruled out other causes of spinal pain such as herniated disk, spinal stenosis, fracture, or tumor?

children.content: Planned procedure, as indicated by 1 or more of the following:

Initial facet neurotomy when both initial and secondary diagnostic (dual diagnostic blocks are necessary to diagnose facet pain) fluoroscopically guided controlled local anesthetic blocks of medial branches of dorsal spinal nerves, or intra-articular facet joint injections, achieve at least 80% pain relief from baseline pain scores
children.question: Has the patient undergone both initial and secondary diagnostic fluoroscopically guided controlled local anesthetic blocks of medial branches of dorsal spinal nerves, or intra-articular facet joint injections, achieving at least 80% pain relief from baseline pain scores?

children.content: Repeat facet neurotomy at the same spinal level(s) when there is a prior history of successful facet neurotomy (50% or more reduction in pain documented for at least 3 months)
children.question: Is there documentation of a prior history of successful facet neurotomy with 50% or more reduction in pain for at least 3 months?
Is there documentation in the medical record indicating the absence of coagulopathy?
Is there documentation in the medical record indicating that the patient has no current infection?
